metadata.description: Claude Crew (a live website of Claude, its helpers and the chats it started) and Codex Bridge (OpenAI Codex as a Claude subagent).

plugins.name: crew-map
plugins.description: Claude Crew: a live website beside the chat (type /crew) showing what Claude, its helpers and the chats it started are doing: each one's status, steps, cost and context, what needs you, the files touched, and a filterable log where every action opens to its diff, output or error. Logs are kept and can be saved with a summary.

plugins.name: codex-bridge
plugins.description: Gives Claude a codex tool: hand a task to OpenAI Codex (your own ChatGPT/Codex subscription) as a subagent, with model and effort choice, per-project memory, named threads you can rename, reset and archive, your plan usage at a glance, and a live pane of what Codex is doing.
